description: The posset, and the last question

participation.context: Drank the posset, read the letter, and did not answer it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the sermon home and kept the stair.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Set the bolster, took the bowl down, and did not touch the writing.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Brought the letter from the Bell and said to answer the last question first.
participation.name: Gilbert Shakespeare

relations.note: the letter, and the last question first
relations.quote: Answer the last one first, brother.

story.body: You stayed in bed. Mistress Ansell had been to church for the house and brought the sermon home with the posset. Gilbert came up with the letter and stopped at the chair. You read the shoes, the cough, and the question about Lent, and you did not answer the last of them. Alse took the old bowl down and left the papers on the stool.

relations.note: the letter, and the last question first
relations.quote: Answer the last one first, brother.

title: Drank the posset and read the letter

participation.context: His hand is on the pot. His face is not in the picture.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the pot is hers, and he is still in the bed

story.body: The picture is the pewter pot and your hand. Your face is not in it.

relations.note: the pot is hers, and he is still in the bed

title: Left the pot on the stool
